v1.0.1 — RINEX 2 parsing fix
A bug-fix release. Upgrade if you read RINEX 2 files or RINEX 3 files without a GLONASS channel header.

## Fixed

- **RINEX 2 observation files are parsed correctly.** The reader started a new epoch on almost every observation line, so RINEX 2 files came back with no satellites. Epoch lines are now matched on their fixed-column layout. A daily 30 s RINEX 2.11 file now reads as 2,880 epochs with every satellite present.
- **GLONASS multipath without a channel table in the header.** RINEX 2 and early RINEX 3.0x headers have no `GLONASS SLOT / FRQ #` record. Every satellite fell back to channel 0 and GLONASS multipath came out near 100 m. The nominal slot-to-channel table now fills the gap, and header values still take precedence. On a mixed GPS+GLONASS RINEX 2.11 file, GLONASS M1C drops from 114.8 m to 0.197 m RMS, in line with GPS.
- Event epochs (flags 2 to 5) no longer produce empty epochs.

## Install

```bash
pip install -U geoveil-mp
```

Everything from [v1.0.0](https://github.com/miluta7/geoveil-mp/releases/tag/v1.0.0) is unchanged: SNR wavelets and first Fresnel zones in Rust, under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.

**Links:** [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/geoveil-mp/1.0.1/) · [Changelog](https://github.com/miluta7/geoveil-mp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · [Website](https://miluta7.github.io/geoveil-mp/)
